The question asks for an American country music singer-songwriter, born in May of 1942, who sang a duet with her ex-husband the same year he released "The Battle."  

From the source [The Battle (George Jones song)], the song "The Battle" was released in 1976 by George Jones. That same year, his duet "Golden Ring" with his estranged ex-wife Tammy Wynette became a #1 hit.  

From [Tammy Wynette], she was born Virginia Wynette Pugh on May 5, 1942, which matches "born in May of 1942."  

Thus, the singer is Tammy Wynette.  

Final answer: Tammy Wynette
